notes: ENX Association maintains TISAX (Trusted Information Security Assessment Exchange) and the ISA (Information Security Assessment) catalog used by the European automotive industry for supplier information security audits.

data.description: The catalog of security requirements used in TISAX assessments. ISA is the question catalog; TISAX (secid:methodology/enx.com/tisax) is the assessment framework that consumes it.
data.notes: Developed by VDA (Verband der Automobilindustrie) and maintained by ENX Association. ISA 6.0 covers Information Security, Prototype Protection, and Data Protection controls mapped to ISO/IEC 27001:2022.

versions_available.note: ISA 6.0 (effective April 2024 for TISAX assessments); aligned with ISO/IEC 27001:2022.
